storage.serviceSub: Manage the local background dashboard service, Windows system tray, and user-level sign-in startup.
storage.autostartLabel: Start at Windows sign-in (HKCU\Run, no admin required)
storage.autostartNoteDefault: Starts the background dashboard silently at Windows sign-in; save again after changing the install path to refresh.
storage.autostartNoteNonWin: Not on Windows; user-level HKCU\Run autostart is only supported on Windows.
storage.autostartNoteCheckout: Running from a source checkout; prefer enabling autostart from a regular install, or save again after changing paths.
storage.trayNote: Provides quick access to open the dashboard, start/stop/restart the service, and open the logs folder.
storage.portNote: Click "Restart Service" after saving for a new port to take effect.
storage.policySub: Stored independently in {ledgerPath}, unaffected by {stateFile} 200-task pruning. When size exceeds the cap, oldest entries roll off cleanly to keep the newest 90%.
storage.maxMbNote: Default 100 MB (min 1 MB); oldest records are pruned to 90% of cap when exceeded.
storage.maxDaysNote: Default 180 days; older records are removed during rotation.
storage.autoRotateLabel: Auto-check and rotate when appending new records
storage.autoRotateNote: When off, rotation only runs when you click "Run Rotation Now" below.
storage.dangerSub: Clears metering records in {ledgerFile} only; keeps your pricing config, harness discounts, and raw receipts in {receiptsDir}.
storage.clearModalBody: This will clear all historical metering records in {ledgerFile} (pricing and retention settings are kept).

agySlots.title: AGY Slot Rotation & Cleanup
agySlots.subtitle: Inspect daily rotating slot states, run non-destructive previews, and perform double-confirmed cleanup on releasable slots.
agySlots.disabledBody: AGY slot rotation is currently disabled (enabled = false). This is not an error; to enable daily rotation and cleanup of empty AGY slot projects, set enabled = true under [agents.antigravity.agy_slots] in agents.toml, configure rotation_tz and grace_hours, and bind at least two dedicated empty AGY project UUIDs.
agySlots.disabledHint: Note: each slot must point to an empty AGY project (no folders or resources), otherwise relative paths may cross-contaminate across slots.
agySlots.loadFailed: Failed to load AGY slot status: {error}
agySlots.retryHint: Click "Refresh Slots" above to retry manually (no automatic polling or automatic cleanup).
agySlots.conditionalUnavailableNote: Unavailable (capability note: whole-slot batch cleanup only; does not block live cleanup availability)
agySlots.operationalNotice: Notice: Do NOT launch agy CLI to resume conversations in the target slot from cleanup start until the full round finishes. Each batch typically takes ~15–60s and may run multiple batches until complete. This card fetches only on initial view and manual refresh — never auto-polled or auto-cleaned.
agySlots.statusDescActive: Active write slot for today: both preview and live cleanup are disabled.
agySlots.statusDescCooling: In cooling grace period: live cleanup disabled; non-destructive preview allowed.
agySlots.statusDescBlocked: Unclosed or active sessions bound: live cleanup disabled; non-destructive preview allowed.
agySlots.statusDescReleasable: Past grace period with no blocking sessions: preview allowed; live cleanup unlocks once all 4 conditions pass.
agySlots.statusDescUnknown: State cannot be verified (guard error or unconfirmed operation): both live cleanup and preview are disabled.
agySlots.slotSelectAria: Select an AGY slot to inspect and manage
agySlots.healthMissingFile: Project registration file missing (project_file_exists = false): verify AGY project registration before proceeding.
agySlots.healthNonEmpty: Project is NOT empty (project_is_empty = false): non-empty projects can cause relative-path cross-contamination! Switch to a dedicated empty project UUID immediately.
agySlots.previewHint: Preview only inventories eligible conversations and never deletes data (~15–60s).
agySlots.previewDisabledActive: Active slot for today — preview is disabled.
agySlots.previewDisabledUnknown: Slot status is unconfirmed — preview is disabled.
agySlots.previewDisabledUnavailable: Cleaner is unavailable (live_cleanup_available = false) — preview disabled.
agySlots.previewDisabledBusy: A preview or cleanup request is already in flight.
agySlots.checkPreviewOk: Valid dry-run preview present for this slot and project UUID
agySlots.checkPreviewMissing: Missing valid preview for this slot and project UUID (run preview first; invalidated on slot switch, rebind, status change, or preview failure)
agySlots.checkConfirmOk: Confirmation input exactly matches slot name ({slot})
agySlots.checkConfirmMissing: Type exact slot name "{slot}" below to confirm
agySlots.checkModalReady: Clicking "Live Cleanup…" requires final approval in a confirmation modal
agySlots.checkCleanerUnavailable: Live cleanup capability is unavailable (live_cleanup_available = false)
agySlots.confirmInputLabel: Type exact slot name to unlock live cleanup
agySlots.liveRunning: Cleaning (multi-batch; do not launch agy CLI)…
agySlots.liveInflightBanner: Slot operation in progress (~15–60s per batch; live cleanup may run multiple batches until the full round finishes). Do NOT launch agy CLI to resume conversations in this slot.
agySlots.invalidatedNotice: Slot selection, project binding, status changed, or preview failed — previous confirmation state was invalidated and input cleared.
agySlots.missingConditionsPrefix: Live cleanup prerequisites not met; no request sent:
agySlots.modalIntro: You are about to run irreversible live cleanup (dry_run = false) on:
agySlots.modalWarnIrreversible: This permanently deletes eligible AGY conversations in this slot and cannot be undone.
agySlots.modalWarnNoCli: Do NOT launch agy CLI to resume conversations in this slot until the full round finishes (~15–60s per batch; multiple batches may run).
agySlots.receiptIncompleteBanner: Cleanup round NOT completed (do not treat as finished) — Outcome: {outcome} · Stop reason: {stopReason}
agySlots.receiptConflictBanner: Blocked by guard or concurrency lock (HTTP 409) — resolve the blockers below and retry
agySlots.receiptBadGatewayBanner: Cleanup worker timed out or returned unconfirmed result (HTTP 502) — structured receipt preserved below
agySlots.receiptErrorBanner: Request unsuccessful (HTTP {status}) — structured receipt and errors preserved below
agySlots.blockingProcessesTitle: Running AGY CLI Processes Detected (Exit Manually)
agySlots.blockingProcessesHint: Exit the AGY CLI processes below manually and retry; the dashboard will not terminate processes for you.
agySlots.conceptHttp200Note: Conversations covered by HTTP 200 receipts only — does NOT mean native removal succeeded.
agySlots.conceptQuarantineNote: Isolated on the same volume (not deleted); does NOT count as freed disk space.
agySlots.conceptLockedNote: Files remained locked/in use or failed verification during quarantine.
agySlots.conceptRemainingNote: Conversations not yet finished — cannot be counted as succeeded.
agySlots.conceptUnconfirmedNote: Conversations with unconfirmed outcome — cannot be counted as succeeded.
agySlots.conceptRejectedNote: Conversations whose deletion was explicitly rejected.
agySlots.quarantineSpaceDisclaimer: Accounting note: same-volume residual quarantine moves files to an isolation folder instead of deleting them; it must NOT be counted as freed disk space.
agySlots.batchNoResiduals: No residual entries recorded for this batch.
agySlots.toastPreviewFailed: Preview did not complete for {slot}; inspect structured receipt below
agySlots.toastLiveIncomplete: Cleanup round incomplete for {slot}; inspect structured receipt below
agySlots.toastConflict: Cleanup blocked for {slot} (HTTP 409); inspect blockers below
agySlots.toastBadGateway: Cleanup unconfirmed for {slot} (HTTP 502); structured receipt preserved
